<function name="SetStart" parent="CEffectData" type="classfunc">
	<description>Sets the start of the effect to be created with this effect data.
<note>Limited to world bounds (+-16386 on every axis) and has horrible networking precision. (17 bit float per component)</note>
</description>
	<realm>Shared</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="start" type="Vector">Start of the effect.</arg>
	</args>
</function>
